name: hot-tabs
description: Reorder VS Code tabs by most edited files in recent Git history and pin the top tabs.

commands.title: Hot Tabs: Reorder and Pin by Git Edit History

hotTabs.days.description: How many days of Git history to use when scoring open tabs.

hotTabs.pinCount.description: How many of the hottest tabs to pin after reordering.

hotTabs.includeZeroScoreTabs.description: Keep open text tabs that have no Git changes in the reorder operation, placing them after scored tabs.

hotTabs.runOnStartup.description: Automatically reorder and pin tabs once when VS Code finishes starting up.

hotTabs.automaticRunIntervalMinutes.description: How often to automatically reorder and pin tabs, in minutes. Set to 0 to disable recurring automatic runs.
